description: Default capability granting renderer access to the get_sidecar_url command. The sidecar process is spawned by Rust via app.shell().sidecar(), so the renderer does not need shell:allow-spawn. core:window:default is read-only, so show/set-focus are granted explicitly: the main window is created hidden and the renderer puts it on screen once the boot splash has painted (ADR-0066). opener:allow-open-url is scoped to the User guide, which Settings › App info's User guide row opens in the default browser (#564); the Popout has no opener permission.
